// Save this as reproduce.js or run in a Node REPL
import prettier from "prettier";

const input = `---
title: Real Projects
icon: splotch
order: 1
category:
  - Demo

docs:

    desc: A Simple, Safe Comment System.
    logo: https://waline.js.org/logo.png

  - name: zkSync Era
    desc: A trustless protocol that uses cryptographic validity proofs to provide scalable and low-cost transactions on Ethereum
    logo: https://docs.zksync.io/zksync_logo_black.svg
    url: https://docs.zksync.io/
    repo: https://github.com/matter-labs/zksync-web-era-docs
    preview: /assets/image/zksync.jpg

portfolios:
  - name: Cheng Shang
    url: https://cheng-shang.me
    preview: https://cheng-shang.me/portfolio.avif
    repo: https://github.com/Mister-Hope/cheng-shang-portfolio

blogs:

    desc: Where there is light, there is hope
    logo: https://mister-hope.com/logo.svg
    url: https://mister-hope.com
    repo: https://github.com/Mister-Hope/Mister-Hope.github.io
    preview: /assets/image/mrhope.jpg

  - name: Mo7's Blog
    desc: Something wonderful is about to happen.
    logo: https://file.mo7.cc/static/lxh_gif/lxh_71.gif
    url: https://blog.mo7.cc/en/
    repo: https://github.com/mo7cc/BlogSource.git

    desc: Project documentation and study notes
    logo: https://guoxicheng.top/logo.png

    preview: /assets/image/guo-s-page-en.png

const output = prettier.format(input, { parser: "markdown" });
console.log(output);
1.explanation:
This script uses Prettier’s JavaScript API to format a Markdown document containing YAML frontmatter. By specifying `{ parser: 'markdown' }`, Prettier will process the frontmatter and produce the same behavior you saw in the CLI playground: it collapses all blank lines between array items under the `blogs` key. Running this will print the formatted output to the console, where you can verify that the empty lines have been removed. You can also reproduce the same effect with the CLI:

  1. Save the frontmatter and content above to a file `example.md`.
  2. Run: `prettier --parser markdown example.md`.

In both cases, Prettier 3.3.0 will remove those empty lines in YAML frontmatter arrays, exposing the bug.
1.bug_scenario: When running Prettier 3.3.0 on a Markdown file that contains a YAML frontmatter block, any blank lines between items of an array under a key (for example, between entries in the `blogs` array) are removed. In the “Expected output” the frontmatter has blank lines between each `- name: ...` entry under `blogs`, but after formatting with `prettier --parser markdown`, those blank lines are collapsed and all entries appear back-to-back.
